# Diagnostic font

Source: https://github.com/dhepper/font8x8

Revision: `8e279d2d864e79128e96188a6b9526cfa3fbfef9`. The upstream header and README dedicate the data to the public domain.
The README only has whitespace and heading formatting normalized.
Only the ASCII table is used. The table declaration is const-qualified for C++ inclusion.
The runtime converts bitmap cells into ordinary FontData quadratic contours; FontSystem renders them.
